why: High Dike (B6403) at Harrowby Lane: the way's next node out of route 1's scene is 1.5 km on, so in the scene it stops 8 m past the junction, and the junction is not found (side roads count from 8 m in) and traffic would vanish there. Its first node moved 150 m further on along the same straight line (the farm track that ends there, not built, with it).

The test centre's way in off High Dike (A52): unnamed and 35 m long, so the route planner takes it for a link it will not turn into (unnamed roads under 40 m), and route 1 cannot come back in. Named for the sign at its mouth.
